## Checklist

- [ ] Branch is named `feature/<ticket>-<slug>`, `fix/<ticket>-<slug>`, or `hotfix/<ticket>-<slug>` (see `CONTRIBUTING.md`)
- [ ] Commit messages follow [Conventional Commits](https://www.conventionalcommits.org/) (`feat:`, `fix:`, `chore:`, …)
- [ ] `yarn lint:check`, `yarn format:check`, `yarn type-check`, `yarn test run`, and `yarn build` all pass locally
- [ ] No new `console.log`, commented-out code, or debug artifacts left behind
- [ ] Docs updated if this changes setup, workflow, or public-facing behavior
- [ ] PR targets `development` (or `main`, only for releases/hotfixes — see `CONTRIBUTING.md` § Pull request workflow)
